pull_request.title: Phase 18: per-device credentials (Credential 1:N)
pull_request.body:
## 摘要

把「唯一性」從 **token** 移到 **分配**：一筆分配可同時掛**多把獨立的 per-device 憑證**（每台裝置一把），各自可單獨撤回。額度／用量／歸戶仍綁在**分配**層 → 多把 token 共用同一配額，不繞過任何限制（**無需軟上限**）。

動機：單一共用 token 的多裝置與輪替體驗差（rotate 連坐全部、忘記複製卡死）。業界做法（GitHub PAT、AWS IAM 雙鑰、gh/gcloud OAuth device flow）皆「每台/每用途一把獨立憑證」。對應原則 1（憑證隔離）+ 原則 2（可追蹤性）。

## 變更

**Schema（migration `0015`，建新表+複製+swap，SQLite/Postgres 同碼）**
- `Credential` 主鍵 `allocation_id`（1:1）→ 獨立 ULID `id`；`allocation_id` 改一般 FK + 索引；新增 `name` / `last_used_at` / `revoked_at`；`token_fingerprint` 維持唯一。
- 既有每列原樣搬 fingerprint/prefix/created_at + 補 `id` + `name="預設"` → **既有 token 零回歸**。

**Service / API**
- `add_credential` / `list_credentials` / `revoke_credential`（軟撤回 `revoked_at`）；`lookup_by_token` 加 `revoked_at IS NULL` + 節流 `last_used_at`。
- member `/me/allocations/{id}/credentials` GET/POST/DELETE（CSRF + 擁有者隔離）。
- admin `/admin/allocations/{id}/credentials` GET/DELETE（留稽核 `credential_revoked`）。

**前端**
- 可複用 `DeviceCredentialsCard`（member 新增/撤回 + 一次性遮罩複製；admin 唯讀清單 + 撤回），接進分配詳情與 admin 分配頁；沿用階段 16 `.responsive-table` RWD。

## 測試

- 新增 8 contract + 2 Postgres 整合（migration 零回歸、多憑證 lookup/revoke）先 Red → Green。
- **501 後端 + 117 前端測試綠；ruff / mypy 零警告；前端 typecheck / lint / build 綠。**

## 部署備註

- 含 migration `0015`，部署時需套用。
- live 驗收：既有成員舊 token 仍可呼叫、可新增一把 / 撤一把。

commit.message:
feat(credentials): Phase 18 — per-device credentials (Credential 1:N)

Move uniqueness from token to allocation: one allocation can now carry many
independent, individually-revocable per-device credentials. Quota / billing /
attribution stay at the allocation layer (many tokens share one quota, so extra
devices bypass no limit — no soft cap needed).

Schema (migration 0015, build-new-table+swap, SQLite+Postgres):
- Credential PK allocation_id -> independent ULID id; allocation_id becomes an
  ordinary indexed FK; add name / last_used_at / revoked_at; fingerprint stays
  unique. Existing rows preserved verbatim + get a "預設" credential -> every
  existing token keeps working (Postgres migration test fixes this as a gate).

Service / API:
- add_credential / list_credentials / revoke_credential (soft revoke via
  revoked_at); lookup_by_token filters revoked_at IS NULL + throttled last_used_at.
- member /me/allocations/{id}/credentials GET/POST/DELETE (CSRF + owner isolation).
- admin /admin/allocations/{id}/credentials GET/DELETE (audited credential_revoked).

Frontend:
- reusable DeviceCredentialsCard (member add/revoke + one-time masked-copy reveal;
  admin read-only list + revoke), wired into allocation-detail + admin allocations;
  reuses Phase 16 .responsive-table RWD.

Tests (TDD): 8 new contract + 2 Postgres integration (zero-regression migration,
multi-credential lookup/revoke); 501 backend + 117 frontend green, ruff/mypy clean.

Knowledge: vision Phase 18 -> done; history detail + one distilled experience lesson.

pull_request.title: feat(cost): cost.json sidecar, rerouted delete gate, plan-reconcile, age-bounded retention (SPEC-029)
pull_request.body:
Implements SPEC-029: retire the unread per-folder `cost.md` for a compact `cost.json` sidecar, reroute both machine consumers to it, add orchestrator-driven post-merge ledger reconciliation, and change merged-SPEC retention from delete-at-merge to keep-then-age-reap. SPEC-026's fail-closed representation invariant is preserved exactly. Bash + bats + wiki only; no TypeScript surface.

## Phase 1 (this commit) — code + unit tests

- **`token-tally.sh`** now writes a compact `cost.json` sidecar keyed by phase kind (`spec` / `plan` / `execute`) instead of `cost.md`. Each value is the full record appended to central `cost.jsonl`. Replace-mine-preserve-sibling write; a plan/execute write never overwrites its sibling. Never blocks; still always exits 0. `render_tally_body`/`extract_section` removed.
- **`cost-represented.sh`** delete gate reads the sidecar (source precedence: any `cost.json` under the folder drives the gate; `cost.md` is a transitional legacy fallback; neither → nothing to lose). An unparseable `cost.json` blocks (fail-closed, SPEC-026 invariant intact).
- **`plan-reconcile.sh`** (new) — plan-arm counterpart to `spec-reconcile.sh`; stamps a `PLAN-NNN` plans-ledger row to `completed` via the guarded `plan-ledger-update.sh` chokepoint. No `gh`/PR scan (orchestrator-driven), best-effort, always exit 0.
- **`spec-archive-merged.sh` + `local-janitor.sh`** — merged-SPEC retention reversal: a merged folder is now kept at merge and age-reaped only past `GAIA_SPEC_RETENTION_DAYS` (default 30) AND when cost-represented. Missing/unparseable `merged_at` → kept (fail-closed). New sixth SessionStart janitor sweep delegates the age-gated reap.

**Gate:** `pnpm typecheck` + `pnpm lint` clean; 163/163 bats green across all named suites; FC-6 guardrails confirmed (manifest untouched, `gaia-active-plan.sh`/`token-tally-git-op.sh` untouched).

Phase 2 (integration oracle + wiki docs + orchestrator reference) follows in a subsequent commit.

pull_request.title: feat(proxy): support service_tier forwarding
pull_request.body:
## Summary
- add explicit `service_tier` support to shared Responses request models and Chat Completions mapping
- support `gpt-5.4` pricing, including the documented standard-tier long-context rates
- apply fast-mode pricing when `service_tier` is `priority`
- persist `service_tier` on request logs and expose it via the request-log API/dashboard UI
- add an Alembic migration for `request_logs.service_tier`
- add OpenSpec changes for forwarding, pricing, and request-log visibility

## Validation
- `uv run pytest tests/unit/test_openai_requests.py tests/unit/test_chat_request_mapping.py tests/integration/test_openai_compat_features.py -q`
- `uv run pytest tests/unit/test_pricing.py tests/unit/test_dashboard_trends.py tests/unit/test_api_keys_service.py tests/integration/test_request_logs_filters.py tests/integration/test_migrations.py -q`
- `cd frontend && bun run test -- src/utils/formatters.test.ts src/features/dashboard/components/recent-requests-table.test.tsx src/features/dashboard/schemas.test.ts`
- `uv run python -m py_compile app/core/usage/pricing.py app/core/usage/logs.py app/core/usage/types.py app/db/models.py app/modules/api_keys/service.py app/modules/proxy/service.py app/modules/request_logs/repository.py app/modules/usage/builders.py`

## Manual verification
- verified a real Codex request through local `codex-lb` with fast mode enabled (`service_tier=priority`)
- verified a standard-tier `gpt-5.4` request through `/v1/responses`
- inspected persisted request-log rows to confirm `service_tier` and cost calculations differ between standard and priority traffic
- verified `GET /api/request-logs?limit=1` returns `serviceTier` for fast-mode entries

## Notes
- `openspec validate --specs` was not run locally because `openspec` is not installed in this environment

pull_request.body:
## Summary

Implements the Query Builder interface for analytics with comprehensive UI components and server-side infrastructure. Refactors the analytics foundation by renaming analytics-v2 to analytics throughout the codebase, flattening the route structure, and adding shared models and utilities.

## Issues

- Issue #3844

## Key Changes

- [apps/ai-dial-admin/src/components/Analytics/QueryBuilder/QueryBuilder.tsx](https://github.com/epam-ai-dial/ai-dial-admin-frontend/blob/feat/analytics-query-builder/apps/ai-dial-admin/src/components/Analytics/QueryBuilder/QueryBuilder.tsx) — Main query builder component with UI for building queries
- [apps/ai-dial-admin/src/app/[lang]/query-builder/page.tsx](https://github.com/epam-ai-dial/ai-dial-admin-frontend/blob/feat/analytics-query-builder/apps/ai-dial-admin/src/app/[lang]/query-builder/page.tsx) — Query builder page route (flattened from /analytics-v2/query-builder)
- [apps/ai-dial-admin/src/app/[lang]/query-builder/actions.ts](https://github.com/epam-ai-dial/ai-dial-admin-frontend/blob/feat/analytics-query-builder/apps/ai-dial-admin/src/app/[lang]/query-builder/actions.ts) — Server actions for query execution
- [apps/ai-dial-admin/src/server/analytics/analytics-data-api.ts](https://github.com/epam-ai-dial/ai-dial-admin-frontend/blob/feat/analytics-query-builder/apps/ai-dial-admin/src/server/analytics/analytics-data-api.ts) — Renamed from analytics-v2-api.ts with updated client interface
- [apps/ai-dial-admin/src/models/analytics/query-builder.ts](https://github.com/epam-ai-dial/ai-dial-admin-frontend/blob/feat/analytics-query-builder/apps/ai-dial-admin/src/models/analytics/query-builder.ts) — Query builder domain models
- [apps/ai-dial-admin/src/components/Menu/menu-configuration.tsx](https://github.com/epam-ai-dial/ai-dial-admin-frontend/blob/feat/analytics-query-builder/apps/ai-dial-admin/src/components/Menu/menu-configuration.tsx) — Updated menu structure for new analytics routes
- [openspec/specs/analytics/spec.md](https://github.com/epam-ai-dial/ai-dial-admin-frontend/blob/feat/analytics-query-builder/openspec/specs/analytics/spec.md) — Renamed from analytics-v2/spec.md with feature specifications

## New Components

- **QueryBuilder** — Main interface component orchestrating all query builder sections
- **FilterGroup / FilterCondition** — Visual filter builder with AND/OR logic
- **Aggregates / GroupBySection / TimeBuckets** — Aggregation and grouping controls
- **FieldCheckboxGrid / TaggedFieldPicker** — Field selection interfaces
- **SelectProjection** — Column/field projection selector
- **SortKeys** — Sort configuration interface
- **SourceSection / SchemaPreviewPopup** — Data source and schema exploration
- **QueryResultSidebar / StatChip** — Results display and statistics
- **ModeSelector** — Query mode selection interface

## Breaking Changes

- Route change: `/analytics-v2/query-builder` → `/query-builder` (flattened)
- API client renamed: `AnalyticsV2DataApi` → `AnalyticsDataApi`
- Folder rename: `src/server/analytics/analytics-v2-api.ts` → `src/server/analytics/analytics-data-api.ts`
- Spec location: `openspec/specs/analytics-v2/` → `openspec/specs/analytics/`

## Checklist

- [x] the pull request name complies with [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/)
- [x] the pull request name ends with `(Issue #3844)`
